relationships.enter00: Disjoint. ENTER 00 (/enter, DirectoryPanel, config/directory.ts) is the desktop full directory route; FT is the mobile contextual overlay. Both reuse Site00FastTravelIcon (EntryToggle.tsx:22,34). /enter is desktop-forced (Site00Context.tsx:32-38) so FT never appears there. ENTER 00 lists SUPPORT + 'BLDR STUDIO'; FT never lists SUPPORT.
relationships.waiting_room_locations: FT RETURN section always links to LOCATIONS (/origin/locations, mobile full directory, locations-directory.ts:30-130) — FT is explicitly 'not a full directory' (fast-travel.ts:2-3); LOCATIONS is. On /origin/locations the header swaps the FT trigger for EXIT 00 and no panel mounts (Site00MobileShell.tsx:47-48,63-69). LOCATIONS includes EVOLVE; FT never offers EVOLVE.
relationships.production_workspace: None. FT never links to /production; production chrome has no FT. Founder reaching /production must use OperatingWorldTopNav (desktop, admin-only) or PwFrame projects nav (mobile admin).
relationships.control_room: FT exposes CTRL ROOM in MY SPACE (public pages), UP NEXT (idnty signed-in, projects) and a dedicated CTRL ROOM profile (PROJECTS, MY SITES, BILLING, SETTINGS, IDNTY). Overlaps MOBILE_SITE_NAV CTRL ROOM bay.
relationships.sites: Two meanings: public /sites (portfolio; redirects to /control/sites when signed in) labelled VIEW/EXPLORE SITES, and /control/sites labelled MY SITES. No site switcher.
relationships.projects: Links to /projects index only; no project selection, no active-project awareness; /project/* only matched for location label.
